title: Revamped Portfolio
content:
I wanted to challenge myself and make a portfolio with just html5, javascript and css. Goal was to do the site in components and to be modular. Normally this kind of project, I would have done with some framework like React, but I wanted to see if I could do this without 3rd party libraries or frameworks.

- HTML5/JS/CSS
